get_full_colormap: get the full colormap as an Nx3 numpy array with colors scaled to 0-255 or 0-1 range
get_random_color: get a single random color from the colormap as an RGB or BGR vector scaled to 0-255
get_random_colors: get N unique random colors from the colormap as a list of RGB or BGR vectors
get_colormap_in_bgr: get the full colormap in BGR format for OpenCV compatibility with values scaled to 0-255
get_colormap_normalized: get the full colormap with colors normalized to the 0-1 range for float tensor workflows
